about_the_game:
The demo version of Arrow Dungeon offers a survival-based action experience where you fend off endless waves of enemies with unlimited arrows.

In a confined space, players must hold out against enemies approaching from all directions. As time passes, enemies become stronger and more numerous—quick decisions and precise shots are the keys to survival.

Arrows are unlimited, allowing for immersive combat without worrying about reloading or ammunition.

Defeated enemies have a chance to drop healing items, giving players a valuable opportunity to recover in critical moments.

Rather than stage-based progression, this is a short but intense survival-focused gameplay experience.

This demo is a mini mode designed to showcase the core combat system of Arrow Dungeon. The full version will feature a variety of stages and expanded content.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains fantasy combat involving bows and arrows.
Players fight against waves of enemies using ranged attacks.
There is no blood or gore, and no depictions of real-world violence, sexual content, or substance use.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4160 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or Radeon HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti or Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound device
